'''''Hieracium spathulatum'''''  is a species of [[Hieracium|hawkweed]] in the family [[Asteraceae]], native to Spain.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/118757#page/669/mode/1up  Scheele, George Heinrich Adolf 1863.  Linnaea 32: 666-667] in Latin</ref>

;Subspecies<ref name=y/>
*''Hieracium spathulatum'' subsp. ''albacetum'' <small>(Arv.-Touv.) Greuter</small>
*''Hieracium spathulatum'' subsp. ''ilergabonum'' <small>(Pau) Greuter</small>
*''Hieracium spathulatum'' subsp. ''spathulatum'' 
*''Hieracium spathulatum'' subsp. ''spathulatiforme'' <small>(Zahn) Greuter</small>
